experiences.title: Gourmet Sushi Tasting
experiences.short_description: An exclusive tasting session with a professional sushi chef.
experiences.long_description: Indulge in an exquisite journey through the art of sushi-making. Join Chef Hiro, who has spent over 20 years refining his craft in Tokyo and London. You’ll learn the fundamentals of fish selection, rice preparation, and plating, all culminating in a tasting of premium-grade sushi paired with traditional sake.

experiences.title: Weekend Surf Trip
experiences.short_description: A two-day surf excursion with gear and lessons included.
experiences.long_description: Escape the city for a sun-soaked weekend at the best surf spots along the Cornish coast. Perfect for beginners and seasoned surfers alike, this package includes professional lessons, board rentals, and shared lodging with fellow surf enthusiasts. End each day around a bonfire, sharing waves and stories under the stars.

experiences.title: Live Jazz Concert
experiences.short_description: An evening of live jazz performances in an iconic venue.
experiences.long_description: Immerse yourself in the soulful melodies of top jazz musicians, performing classic standards and modern interpretations alike. This intimate show is set in a historic concert hall known for its warm acoustics and vibrant atmosphere. Guests will enjoy table seating, optional dinner service, and a curated wine list.

experiences.title: Yoga & Mindfulness Retreat
experiences.short_description: A rejuvenating getaway focused on yoga, meditation, and holistic therapies.
experiences.long_description: Rediscover your inner balance with a three-day retreat in the tranquil countryside. Your stay includes daily guided yoga sessions, mindfulness workshops, and spa treatments. Surrounded by lush greenery, you’ll learn techniques for stress reduction and personal well-being that you can carry back into your everyday life.

experiences.title: BAO Dining Experience
experiences.short_description: Savor authentic Taiwanese steamed buns at BAO.
experiences.long_description: Indulge in a culinary journey at BAO, where traditional Taiwanese flavors meet modern culinary techniques. Enjoy a variety of steamed buns, each crafted with precision and passion, offering a unique taste of Taiwan in the heart of the city.

experiences.title: Lyle's Tasting Menu
experiences.short_description: Experience a seasonal tasting menu at the Michelin-starred Lyle's.
experiences.long_description: Delight in a seasonal tasting menu at Lyle's, a Michelin-starred restaurant known for its minimalist approach and focus on British ingredients. Each dish is a testament to the rich culinary heritage of the region, offering a memorable dining experience.

experiences.title: Yonder Flights
experiences.short_description: Explore the world by air with Yonder Flights.
experiences.long_description: Take to the skies and explore global destinations with Yonder Flights. Enjoy the flexibility of booking with any airline at any time, making your travel experiences seamless and rewarding.

experiences.title: Woodland Cabin Retreat
experiences.short_description: Unwind in a secluded woodland cabin getaway.
experiences.long_description: Escape the hustle and bustle of city life with a retreat to a cozy woodland cabin. Surrounded by nature, this experience offers tranquility, fresh air, and the perfect opportunity to reconnect with oneself or loved ones.

experiences.title: Virtual Mixology Class
experiences.short_description: Learn the art of cocktail making from home.
experiences.long_description: Join a live virtual mixology class where expert bartenders guide you through crafting classic and contemporary cocktails. Perfect for a fun night in or enhancing your home bartending skills.

experiences.title: Outdoor Rock Climbing Adventure
experiences.short_description: Challenge yourself with an outdoor rock climbing session.
experiences.long_description: Experience the thrill of outdoor rock climbing with professional instructors. Whether you're a beginner or an experienced climber, this adventure offers routes for all levels amidst stunning natural landscapes.

experiences.title: Gourmet Chocolate Workshop
experiences.short_description: Create your own chocolates in a hands-on workshop.
experiences.long_description: Dive into the world of chocolate making with this interactive workshop. Learn about the history of chocolate, techniques for crafting truffles and pralines, and take home your delicious creations.
